summary.zh: 把文章或多图图文发布到公众号
summary.en: Publish articles and image posts to WeChat

description.zh: 向公众号推送文章或多图图文，文章可接受 HTML、Markdown 和纯文本三种输入。Markdown 里的普通外链会默认转成文末引用，更符合平台阅读习惯。需要公众号接口权限，或可由本机 Chrome 接管。
description.en: Sends articles or multi-image posts to a WeChat Official Account, taking HTML, Markdown or plain text. Ordinary Markdown links become bottom citations for a platform-friendly result. Needs account API access or a Chrome instance.
